id./param/scenario/cs/c_100_cs_010.pack|cs_:
"Gefaaah... I'm so hungry I can't stand it!
  Despair more, in this endless nightmare!
  I'll starve to death at this rate!

"Hey, you! What are you doing there!
  What do you plan to do with that person!?

"Gefafa... Tasty ingredients have appeared.
  I'll make you my meal too,
  I, Gloomnivore, servant of the evil god.

"Thanks to the evil god's awakening,
  tremendous power surges through me!
  Enough to devour all the world's despair!

"This grieving warrior is what remains of
  the Dundrasil king, who fell so cruelly
  in the tragedy sixteen years ago...

"The Dundrasil king!?
  That warrior can't be... Irwin!?

"Irwin was king and the strongest warrior
  of Dundrasil. And, {var:1}...
  your father.

"His kingdom fallen, his loved ones dead,
  this man's despair is a gourmet full course.

"Once tasted, his despair is unforgettable.
  I could eat it for sixteen years
  and never tire. But...

"No matter how much I eat, I'm not full.
  His despair alone won't do!
  Next, I'll devour your fresh despair!
